༄༅/ /gu drag rgyun khyer dregs pa zil gnon kun las rnam rgyal bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gu drag rgyun khyer dregs pa zil gnon kun las rnam rgyal bzhugs so//

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ༈ /na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyis rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas sgrub nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca' 'o: lan gsum/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shuddho ྅haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las stong gsum 'di padma dbang drag rol pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i dbus su: suṃ las rdo rje brag rdzong dmar nag 'bar ba'i steng du: e las chos 'byung mthing nag 'khrug pa'i nang du: hūm̐ las nyi ma'i gur khang dbus su: pad nyi 'byung po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la: chos sku skye ba med pa'i dbyings: longs sku snying rje'i bdag nyid: rgyal ba kun 'dus yi dam gu ru drag po'i sku shar ba ni: srin po khros pa'i gzugs can: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang mnyam du gnam lcags kyi phur pa thog gi tsha tsha 'bebs pa 'phyar ba: g.yon bhan dmar 'dzin pa'i sdig mdzub kyi rtser me yi sdig pa ra rtsa'i sprul pa stong gsum g.yo ba: dbu skra snum nag gyen du brdzes pa'i spyi gtsug tu: bla ma tshe dpag med mngon sum bzhugs pa: mi pags dang glang chen ko ba'i stod g.yogs: stag pags kyi sham thabs: sbrul dang rus pa: rin po che'i dbu rgyan: rna rgyan: mgul rgyan: brang rgyan: ska rags: gdu bu sogs brgyad dang : khrag zhag thal chen sogs dpal gyi chas dgu'i brjid pa: me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su drag po'i sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs shing g.yon brkyang gis 'gying pa'i pang na yum mkha' 'gro ma mthing nag gri thod 'dzin pa'i 'khril thabs su 'khyud cing spyi bor phag zhal ngur ba: gzig sham dang cha lugs gzhan yab dang 'dra ba: yab kyi spyi bor bya khyung: dpral bar 'jam dpal:

mgrin par rta mgrin: thugs kar phyag rdor: lte ba mkha' 'gro ma: gsang gnas yakṣa me dbal rnams gsal bar gyur: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub phyir: byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol: gsol 'debs tshig 'dis nga bos tshe: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams: padma nga yi tshul du 'byon: the tshom ma byed phyi rabs rnams: rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros: mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i nad gdon sgrib gnyis zhi: tshe dpal yon tan rgyas: rlung sems dang snang srid bdag gi dbang du 'du: mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rtsa sbur la me shor ba ltar ming med thal bar brlag ste thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod: rgyal ba rnams mchod cing byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad rang gi snying la sib sib thim par bsam la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ: sngags 'di brgya yis 'phral rkyen sel: stong gis lha 'dre dbang du bsdud: khri yis sngon las sdig sgrib sbyangs: 'bum gyis mchog gi dngos grub thob: ces gsungs so: a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ a: ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa: ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣā& yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di mahā shra ba na: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa te no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri ya/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/

badzri bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ dbyangs gsal ye dhar yig brgya lan gsum brjod mthar/ snang srid 'od zhu rang la thim: rang yang hūm̐ bsdu de yang yal: slar yang snang grags rigs gsum kun: lha sngags chos sku'i bkra shis shog: dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas nas: phrin las nam mkhar mnyam par shog: ces shin tu bsdus pa rgyun khyer 'di: sangs rgyas bla ma'i rtsa gsum dril sgrub: sa gur dregs pa zil gnon: tshe dbang nye brgyud rong ston ma bcas kyi dbang thob na legs: ces gsungs so: bkra shis par shog/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
